title: AgriHackathon project wall
description: Ideas, rooted in real problems. Explore what teams are building and Star the projects you want to see grow.

roundCopy.UNCONFIGURED: Projects can be displayed before voting opens. Voting dates have not been announced; current Stars do not automatically count toward the award.
roundCopy.NOT_OPEN: Explore the projects first. Add a Star during the voting window, or actively confirm an existing Star, to participate. Stars removed before the close do not count.
roundCopy.OPEN: Star the projects you support. Event Stars determine the award; the Star button shows the project's all-time total.
roundCopy.CLOSED: Voting has closed. You can still Star projects, but later activity will not change this event's frozen result.

rules.window: Add a Star during the window or actively confirm a Star added earlier to count it for this edition. Stars removed before the close do not count.
rules.account: Each ANS account may contribute one Star per project and may support multiple projects.
rules.team: Stars from the project publisher, current active team members and members on the official event roster do not count toward the popularity award for their own team.
rules.total: All-time project Stars and eligible event Stars are shown separately. Projects must remain published and approved to be eligible.
rules.tie: Projects with the highest positive event Star count win. Equal top counts share the award. No valid votes means no award.
rules.frozen: Voting dates are locked when voting begins. Results are frozen at the close; later Stars, removals or project status changes do not rewrite them.

eventUnconfigured: This edition is not connected yet. Official team binding is unavailable; follow the event guide for confirmed arrangements.
finalResultsHint: These eligible vote results were frozen at the close and are retained separately from all-time Stars.
noWinner: No project received valid votes. No popularity award is assigned.
emptyBody: Only real published projects bound to registered teams appear here. Projects built outside ANS are welcome.
noSearchHint: Try a keyword from the project name or search for a team.
submitTitle: Bring your project to the wall
submitDescription: Build wherever you choose. Publish a free project, bind it to your team, then complete the required stage submission. No AI generation or compute credits are required.
loginSubmitHint: Sign in to choose your published project and registered team. Publication requires your explicit confirmation; private projects are never added automatically.
loginManageHint: Sign in with a staff account that can configure the event rules.
publishBody: Describe the project, its problem, repository and demo. This entry point presets the AgriHackathon wall category and free display.
reviewHint: New projects must pass review before publication. Saving a draft or requesting review does not put a project on the wall.
bindBody: As the team owner or administrator, select your registered team and approved public project. ANS creates the linked entry materials for free.
noTeamTitle: No team you can manage yet
noTeamBody: Register for this edition and confirm that you are the team's owner or administrator. Other members should contact their team lead.
boundBody: The project is connected to your entry. Being on the wall is not a formal stage submission: continue to check the repository version, demo and stage requirements.
boundUnpublished: The link is retained, but the project is not currently published and cannot appear on the wall or qualify for the current award. Check its review and publication status in project management.
noOffer: No eligible project yet. Select a free, approved project you own in the AgriHackathon wall category. Projects awaiting review cannot be selected.
offerHint: Only your approved, free projects in the AgriHackathon wall category appear here.
consent: I am authorized to publish this team's project description, repository and demo links, and agree to link the project to the team for event display and popularity voting. Private inputs and internal materials remain private. Each team can bind one project.
uncertain: We cannot confirm whether this link was saved. Refresh and check the binding receipt before taking another action.
manageDescription: Set this edition's voting window. Public projects, team links and valid votes are retained together; judging and advancement are handled separately.
staffOnly: This account cannot configure voting rules for this edition.
configureHint: Enter dates in Beijing time. Once voting begins, dates are locked and no new project bindings are accepted. Finish publication, review and team binding for all candidates in this edition before scheduling the confirmed voting window.
locked: Voting has started or ended. This edition's voting dates are locked.
configureConsent: I have checked that the candidates in this edition are published and linked to teams, and verified the voting dates. New bindings stop and dates lock when voting begins. Eligible Stars count during the window; publishers and team members cannot vote for their own team. Equal top counts share the award, zero votes means no award, and results freeze at the close.
saved: Voting dates saved. The latest event status appears below.

errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: We could not read or confirm the result. Refresh and try again.
errors.ACCOUNT_CHANGED: Your account has changed. Refresh before continuing with this account.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the selected team, project and confirmation.
errors.INVALID_WINDOW: Choose valid opening and closing dates. Closing must be later than opening.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: The project or voting rules changed. Refresh and check before retrying.
errors.AGRI_NOT_CONFIGURED: This edition is not connected yet. Wait for staff confirmation.
errors.AGRI_WORKSPACE_DISABLED: Changes for this edition are not currently enabled.
errors.AGRI_WALL_ALREADY_BOUND: This team or project already has a link. Refresh to check the receipt.
errors.AGRI_WALL_LISTING_UNAVAILABLE: The project changed or no longer meets publication, free-price or category requirements.
errors.AGRI_POPULARITY_LOCKED: Voting dates are locked once voting starts.
errors.AGRI_REVISION_CONFLICT: The record was updated. Refresh and check it.
errors.AGRI_WALL_PUBLIC_PROJECT_REQUIRED: Choose an approved, free public AgriHackathon project you own.
errors.AGRI_WALL_PROJECT_MISMATCH: This team has entry materials for another project. Check the record and contact staff.
errors.AGRI_WALL_BINDING_CLOSED: Project binding for this edition is closed. Contact event staff.
errors.AGRI_WALL_CATEGORY_LOCKED: A linked project cannot change its event category.
errors.AGRI_WALL_REQUIRED: Link your public project to the team before making a formal stage submission.
errors.AGRI_WALL_VERSION_CONFLICT: The project version changed. Refresh and check the latest content before binding.
errors.AGRI_POPULARITY_FUTURE_WINDOW_REQUIRED: Opening must be in the future and closing must be later than opening.
errors.AGRI_POPULARITY_WINDOW_LOCKED: Voting dates are locked once voting starts.
errors.AGRI_POPULARITY_REVISION_CONFLICT: Another staff member changed the voting dates. Refresh and check them.
errors.AGRI_EDITION_NOT_CONFIGURED: This edition is not connected yet. Wait for event staff confirmation.
errors.AGRI_WORKSPACE_NOT_CONFIGURED: This edition has no configured workspace. Contact event staff.
errors.AGRI_TEAM_MANAGER_REQUIRED: The team owner or administrator must link the project.
errors.AGRI_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: This edition has no matching team entry. Refresh and check registration.
errors.AGRI_SCOPE_REQUIRED: You cannot configure voting rules for this edition.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please try again shortly.
errors.ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: This account is unavailable. Sign in again or contact the organizers.
errors.CONFLICT: The record changed. Refresh and check it before continuing.

entryFlow: All-in-one flow: Read rules & claim compute → Register & publish to wall → Share to rally Stars → Compete for Top 10 Finalists & final rankings.
submissionWallReady: Your team is linked to a public project. Use its entry material version, check the stage requirements, then submit.
submissionWallMissing: Your team has no wall project yet. Publish a free project, pass review and ask the team owner or administrator to bind it.
submissionWallSync: Sync the current public project version to your entry materials. Previously submitted stage versions remain unchanged.
submissionOwnerHint: The project owner must also be the team owner or administrator to link it.
confirmVote: Count this Star for this edition
voteConfirmed: Support saved. Check the refreshed eligible event Star count.
voted: This Star counts for this edition
ownTeamVote: You can Star your team's project, but your Star does not count toward its popularity award.
voteConfirmHint: You already Starred this project. Confirm it during the voting window to participate in this edition.
syncDone: Entry materials synced. Continue checking your stage submission.
bindingClosed: Voting has begun and new project binding is closed. Linked teams can still sync their existing project and complete stage materials.
bindingDone: Project and team linked. Check the receipt and continue your formal stage submission.
freeDisplayBody: The wall introduces public projects for discovery and judging. Visitors can open your demo or repository directly. Wall publication and entry records are free.
shareCopied: Rally message copied! Share it with friends to collect Stars
shareText: 🔥 Check out our AgriHackathon project "{title}" by team {team} ({stars} valid Stars so far)! Give us a Star to help us reach the Top 10 Finalists 👉 {url}
